verdict.rationale: Trilegal has a combined IP group page stating it advises on 'the full spectrum of IP, including... patents.' Its documented patent work is litigation and SEP/FRAND licensing, so prosecution and portfolio strategy are implied at most. Missing for 10: explicit patent drafting/filing/prosecution services, portfolio strategy offering, named patent practitioners, a dedicated patent group page, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages

citations.quote: Our team advises on the full spectrum of IP, including trademarks, copyrights, patents, designs, trade secrets, and confidential information
